story.title: A journey built around communities
story.description: An illustrative account adapted from the supplied reference. Dates and milestones are demo content.

paragraphs: The reference story begins with a volunteer-led screening tent in Buguruni, Dar es Salaam. The idea was simple: make a routine health check easier to access.
The model expanded towards mobile diagnostics, rural visits and a clearer pathway from screening to referral.

team.title: People behind community care
team.description: Illustrative profiles from the supplied reference; names, qualifications and affiliations have not been verified.

cards.title: Dr. Neema Mushi, MD, MMed
cards.text: Dr. Neema Mushi has spearheaded mobile health screening drives across 14 Tanzanian regions. She holds a Master of Medicine from Muhimbili University of Health and Allied Sciences (MUHAS) and advises national task forces on hypertension and diabetes triage protocols.
details: Public Health Medicine & Chronic Disease Surveillance

cards.title: Dr. Juma Rashid, MD
cards.text: Over 12 years organizing remote field medical clinics and emergency triage logistics in Lake Zone and southern highlands. Expert in cold-chain logistics and rapid mobile laboratory deployment.

cards.title: Rehema Kassim, MSc, RN
cards.kicker: Director of Community Nursing & Youth Health
cards.text: Leads our network of 400+ community health volunteers and school wellness clubs. Rehema coordinates adolescent reproductive health literacy and nutrition counselling modules.

cards.title: Baraka Mwakasege, BSc, MPH
cards.kicker: Lead Health Informatics & Field Monitoring Specialist
cards.text: Oversees the AfyaCheck digital registration and DHIS2 data synchronization. Baraka ensures patient privacy compliance and automated ward-level reporting.
details: MPH (London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine)
